title: Mochizuki Honami — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... Which should I choose...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Is something bothering you, Kohane?
Do you need any help?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami...!
No, it's nothing all that serious...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you know how we're supposed to choose what committee we're going to be in during our next homeroom? I'm still undecided.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I don't blame you.
I mean, there are so many to choose from.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You were on the animal caretaker committee last year, yes?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was!
I had a lot of fun, but lately I've been so busy practicing my singing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
The animal caretaker committee's more involved compared to the others since you have to clean up after the animals and such.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Exactly. They're living creatures, so I'd feel awful if I started making everyone else fill in and take care of them for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I was thinking I should probably join a committee that involves less of a time commitment.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I see.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Do you know which committee you're going to join, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm thinking about staying with the cleanup committee.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You are?!
Does that mean you like working as a member of that committee?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I honestly don't know much about it...
Can you tell me more?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, we're mainly tasked with keeping the school clean.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That includes the gym's storeroom, the stairs, the rooftop and quite a few other places that students don't normally clean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That means you and everyone on the committee are the reason our school's such a nice place to be.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I don't know about that...
But I really appreciate the positive feedback.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We also make posters for the school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Posters?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, ones with slogans on them to remind students not to litter and to keep the classrooms clean.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I've seen those in the corridor.
I didn't know they were made by the cleanup committee.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I remember talking with Minori about some that looked really cool and abstract...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is she talking about the ones I drew...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm less against drawing now, but I still feel a little embarrassed when I think about people seeing my work...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Still...
Making posters and helping keep the school clean doesn't sound too bad. Maybe I could...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kohane, are you interested in joining?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm sure keeping the school clean for everyone isn't easy, but making posters and stuff sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then...
Why don't we both volunteer to be on it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not many people choose to join this committee, chiefly because keeping the school clean is a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But seeing everyone enjoy the places that I cleaned puts such a big smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I get to play a small part in brightening up people's days, which makes the effort I put in worth it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really admire how you can work so hard for the sake of others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I just like doing those sorts of tasks.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, as you pointed out earlier, this committee isn't as involved as some of the other ones...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, since you've taken an interest in joining, it'd be nice if we could be on it together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, I'll give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I do think it would be fun to be on this committee, and it not being as involved as some of the other ones is a big plus...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But above all else, I'd feel a lot better knowing that you'd be there with me, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have to learn to walk before I can run, but my hope is that you'll be willing to show me the ropes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Of course...!
Let's do our best together.
